column1: Supplier Selection WPM - PROBOCA Case 2 (frozen boneless skinless chicken breast from Brazil)
Weighted Point Method matrix, RFQ log, quotation summary, market benchmark and SENASICA plant list. Version of October 6, 2026.

STATUS: provisional. No supplier has answered the RFQ yet. The 8 criteria that depend on a quotation (43% of the weight) are held at a neutral 3 for every supplier, so today's ranking comes only from public evidence.
1. Send the RFQs and log them in 'RFQ_Log' (date sent, screenshot file name, response date).

2. Type each written quotation into 'Quotes'. The sheet converts to US cents per lb, compares the FOB price with the Comex Stat 2026 benchmark, suggests a C1 score and checks the plant SIF against SENASICA's list.
3. Replace the yellow provisional scores (value 3) in 'WPM' with the real scores, using the scales in 'Criteria'. Totals, rank and chart update by themselves.
Blue text = input typed by the team.  Black text = formula.  Green text = link to another sheet.  Yellow fill = cell to fill or update when RFQ answers arrive.
Scores run from 1 (worst) to 5 (best). Weights are in 'Criteria' and must add up to 100% (check cell at the bottom of 'WPM').
SENASICA (2026). Sistema de informacion de consulta de plantas autorizadas, Carnicos, Brasil. https://sistemasssl.senasica.gob.mx/PlantaAcreditada/ (consulted Sep 24 and Oct 6, 2026).
MDIC (2026). Comex Stat, Brazilian exports, NCM 0207.14.22, destination Mexico. https://comexstat.mdic.gov.br/ (data updated Oct 6, 2026).
Evidence scores: company websites and reports cited in the manual (Supplier Selection Manual - PROBOCA Case 2, section 1 and Appendix D).
